notes.title: Million Monster Militia (MMM) Patch Notes - Version 1.02D
notes.content:
Updates and Fixes:
[list]
[*] Militia Choices Check: Added a check to prevent the game from freezing when there are no units available to add to the militia.
[*] Ghost Bug Fix: Resolved an issue where the Ghost unit might lock the game.
[*] Transformation Mechanic: Units marked for destruction but protected will now successfully transform.
[*] Engineer Unit Fix: The Engineer unit now correctly resets its "uses" after each turn.
[*] Text Corrections: Various text and description errors have been fixed for clarity and accuracy.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 Post Launch Support
notes.content:
Update 1.02b Patch Notes

🛠️ Fixes:
[list]
[*] USES bug: Units now correctly retain their uses across bosses.
[*] Reaver: Now correctly saves you from going below 2 health. It also no longer conflicts with Extra Life saves, Stasis Ring, killing the boss, multiple Reavers, and Medkits that bring you above 2.
[*] Terror Inc Squad: Now has the correct members.
[*] Mirror Demon: Damage is now correct (again).
[*] Dynamic Choices: Add To Militia choices in the Prologue and other mods like Banned are now dynamic, showing only what is available.
[*] Intro: No longer plays after the first level of the prologue has been won.
[*] No Help Mod: Tower of Retribution and other recruits that are supposed to be removed now are actually removed.
[*] Ooze: Destruction timing is quicker.
[*] Bookshelf: No longer sets itself for destruction on the first round if not near a human or demon.
[*] Custom Mode: Should now always unlock successfully after completing the prologue.
[*] Other various bug fixes
[/list]

▶️ Additions:
[list]
[*] New Mod - Receive Reaver: After defeating a boss, they toss a Reaver into your militia.
[*] Reaver VFX/SFX: New visual and sound effects when Reaver is activated ☠️.
[*] Scientific Notation: If damage numbers exceed 1 sextillion (Qi), they will switch to scientific notation.
[/list]

🔁 Changes:
[list]
[*] Biologist: No longer destroys books but reads them while permanently gaining base damage.
[*] Hydra: Increases its base damage if it OR adjacent monsters are marked for destruction.
[*] Phoenix: Now has an 85% chance to protect itself.
[*] Hustle Goblin: Permanently doubles its base damage if you deal more damage to a boss than before during this run; if not, the goblin loses 10% of its base damage. Goblin damage is not accounted for when comparing the most damage to a boss.
[*] Graveyard: Now gains bonus damage for every Human, Beast, Monster, Undead, Demon, or Plant that was ever marked for destruction.
[*] Grace Embrace Mod: Will only transform Humans, Demons, Beasts, and Monsters into Undead when they are in the front row.
[*] Recruiter: Will no longer recruit units of 'special' rarities or certain units in mods like Banned or other limited recruitment pools.
[*] Giant Bird: Now grants +2 bonus damage to adjacent units that are protected.
[/list]

🏁🏳️ Campaign Balance Changes:
[list]
[*] Prologue Levels: Slightly easier.
[*] Code Name: Shrine Over Me: Starting squad now includes a Convention Hall, and the bosses' health was adjusted accordingly.
[*] Los Angeles: Boss curve has been slightly lowered.
[*] San Francisco: Number of bosses has been adjusted.
[*] Some Prologue Cities: Boss-health ramps were slightly lowered.
[/list]

⚠️ Warning:
This version is not compatible with any "CONTINUE RUN" you have in progress, so it will be gone. Consider finishing your current run before updating!

notes.title: Million Monster Militia Launches out of Early Access with Full Campaign!
notes.content:
[h1]We've Launched![/h1]
Million Monster Militia has launched, and we've added a 75-level campaign, taking us from Boston to Baltimore to Boise. Over Early Access, we've added a bunch of stuff. If you've been following us throughout, you've voted on new pieces - the Enchantress and Siphon, encountered Goats from Hell, lawyered up with a new starting squad, ascended, and now, the biggest of all...

[h1]The NEW Campaign[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44125927/8db582a2c3172ece0b770e98c391c30b5ffb106d.png[/img]
Million Monster Militia's brand new campaign takes you through 75 cities across America and newly-annexed Montreal.

Start on the East Coast, and work your way across the continent with a different challenge with each stop: at our nation's capitol, you'll start with the Element Squad - two Enchantresses, a Laser Frog, some Fire, and a Whale; and in Cleveland, your Undead turn on you, and heal the bosses instead of hurting them.

We won't spoil much more than that, but you can give it a go right now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2358770/Million_Monster_Militia/

[h1]Have You Played Custom Game Mode?[/h1]
If you haven't played a Custom Game, this allows you to mix in everything from a starting squad of Holy Cows to bosses with a million health:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44125927/813c8561df729aced426c68b431058183da645e8.png[/img]
[h2]Modifiers: Challenges and Boons[/h2]
This includes dozens of modifiers like these:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44125927/0adf5580fc1e9056f1535dcf95b9d730aa079e97.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Demon Goats - After each fight, you sacrifice a column of units and summon an invincible demon goat with their combined power.
[*] Vegetarian - All units now have the type “Plant”
[*] I like it Rare - Only draft Rare and Very Rare units
[*] And 41 more!
[/list]
[h2]Variant Starting Squads[/h2]
Along with the modifiers, these greatly change your choices in the early-game:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44125927/6f9703fd880689b5158ef2179d753a353603e07a.png[/img]
This includes stuff like this:
[list]
[*] Laser frogs! (2 Laser Frogs, 2 Whales, 1 Wisp)
[*] Dragons! (2 Red Dragons, 3 Sheep)
[*] Science! (1 Writer, 1 Biologist, 1 Doctor, 1 Alchemist)
[*] And 27 more!
[/list]
[h1]Save America![/h1]
Cross the continent, do battle with umpteen demon bosses, and free America. Now out of Early Access. You heard it here first!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2358770/Million_Monster_Militia/

notes.title: Hotfix v0.095B
notes.content:
🛠 Hotfix 0.095B is live!

We've squashed a pesky bug that was messing up how big numbers looked in several spots:

[list]
[*] Boss Intro Health Number
[*] Gameplay Boss Health Number
[*] Boss Damage Number
[*] Unit Damage Number
[*] Hover Damage Number

Stumbled upon another one? Snap a screenshot and hit us up. Big thanks for helping us keep the game smooth and bug-free! 🙏

notes.title: Major Update #3 - 140 Trillion Custom Game Modes
notes.content:
[h1]140,792,940,288,000 To Be Approximate[/h1]
You can now mix and match 21 game modifiers in [b]Custom Game Mode[/b]. Some of these are great together. Some of them are mutually-exclusive. Some of them are bad ideas: like, the mode that does your homework for you, but then the mode that eats your homework. Don't use those together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44125927/0adf5580fc1e9056f1535dcf95b9d730aa079e97.gif[/img]

Read on:
[h2]GRAVE EMBRACE[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44125927/70ead5e5e149f48aad47dac039863f481572caeb.gif[/img]
[list]
[*]Functionality: Units in the front row are transformed into a random undead unit.
[/list]
[h2]SACRIFICE:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Functionality: After defeating a boss, players can send a column of units to hell.
[*]Reward: Gain a goat that inherits the total base damage of the sacrificed column.
[*]Bonus: The acquired base damage is also granted to every other goat in the player's militia.
[/list]
[h2]PERSISTENT HEALTH:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Feature: Players have 40 health.
[*]Key Change: Health levels no longer reset after each boss encounter.
[/list]
[h2]GOLD FOREVER:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Benefit: Gold remains always protected throughout the game.
[/list]
[h2]EXTINCTION:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Effect: At the start of the game, randomly remove all units of one specific type from the game.
[/list]
[h2]HELLDOG ETERNAL[/h2]
[list]
[*]Functionality: Hellhounds in the game no longer self-destruct.
[/list]
[h2]PLANTING A BOMB[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44125927/47d66a2d15e603731b040af0e4b6fc700944c1aa.gif[/img]
[list]
[*]Functionality: After defeating a boss, they toss a Nuke or Time Bomb into your militia.
[*]Impact: Introduces an additional layer of risk and strategy post-boss battles, demanding careful planning to mitigate the damage from these explosive surprises.
[/list]

[h2]DIRE DIRE DOGS[/h2]
[list]
[*]Feature: Deploying a Dire Wolf adds another Dire Wolf to the militia.
[*]Benefit: This modifier effectively doubles the number of Dire Wolves each time you deploy, enhancing strategies that focus on these units and potentially leading to rapid militia expansion.
[/list]
[h2]UNDEAD FRIEND[/h2]
[list]
[*]Effect: All undead units use their damage to heal the boss instead of damaging it.
[*]Strategic Shift: This modifier completely changes the role of undead units in the game, turning them into support units for the boss rather than offensive units. Players need to carefully consider the use of undead units under this modifier.
[/list]
[h2]UNHOLY PEOPLE[/h2]
[list]
[*]Change: Human units transform into a ghost or skeleton after deployment. (Priests, Paladins and IAO are immune to this effect)
[*]Implication: This modifier encourages a shift away from relying heavily on Human Type units or adapting to the new forms these units take upon deployment.
[/list]
[h2]BANNED[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44125927/7564bf64c6697217fd313d6cb474311dc699f0e0.gif[/img]
[list]
[*]Rule: Selecting a new unit to add to the militia results in that unit being removed from the game.
[*]Tactical Consideration: This modifier demands careful selection of new units, as each choice permanently affects the available unit pool. Players must strategize with a long-term view of their militia composition.
[/list]
[h2]KILLER RICHES[/h2]
[list]
[*]Feature: Gain 15 gold in your militia after defeating a boss.
[*]Advantage: This modifier provides a significant boost to your resources, allowing for more strategic flexibility and unit upgrades.
[/list]
[h2]ALWAYS EMPPIN'[/h2]
[list]
[*]Effect: Always have a single EMP unit in every deployed militia.
[*]Strategy Shift: Ensures constant availability of EMP units, offering consistent utility and a stable element in your militia composition.
[/list]
[h2]BURNY HOT[/h2]
[list]
[*]Change: Fire units no longer mark themselves for destruction.
[*]Implication: Enhances the viability of fire-based strategies by increasing the longevity of fire units.
[/list]
[h2]SLIPPERY WET[/h2]
[list]
[*]Update: Water units no longer mark themselves for destruction.
[*]Benefit: Bolsters water-based strategies by allowing water units to remain on the field longer.
[/list]
[h2]HUMANITARIAN[/h2]
[list]
[*]Rule: All units, upon being selected, turn into the Human type.
[*]Tactical Consideration: This modifier encourages a shift towards human-centric strategies, transforming your militia's composition with each unit selection.
[i]Note: Cannot be active simultaneously with "VEGETARIAN".[/i]
[/list]
[h2]VEGETARIAN[/h2]
[list]
[*]Functionality: All units, when selected, become Plant type.
[*]Strategic Shift: This modifier demands a rethinking of unit choices and synergies, pivoting towards plant-based strategies.
[i]Note: Cannot be active simultaneously with "HUMANITARIAN".[/i]
[/list]
[h2]MAN MADE[/h2]
[list]
[*]Feature: Limit your militia to only Humans, Structures, Constructs, and Items.
[*]Challenge: This modifier narrows the scope of usable units, demanding creativity and strategic prowess with a restricted unit pool.
[/list]
[h2]NO HELP[/h2]
[list]
[*]Directive: Removes Medkit, Sacrificial Spam, Extra Health, Doctor, and Extra Life from the game.
[*]Implication: Increases the difficulty by eliminating key support and survival options, requiring players to adapt their strategies for sustainability without these aids.
[/list]
[h2]LUMP ROLL[/h2] 
[list]
[*]Effect: Acquire 50 rerolls and never gain another one throughout the game
[*]Implication: Tradeoffs between control over early picks or control over later picks (and synergy with… certain units).
[/list]
[h2]ROLL AGAIN[/h2] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44125927/00c216e3a452985b0949bc7d643ed49e830dc985.gif[/img]
[list]
[*]Effect: Gain an addition REROLL each round
[*]Implication: more control over your picks, more consistent militias!
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Grey Goo now transfers damage when transforming
[*]Siphon now works properly
[/list]
[h1]QoL features:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added mouse wheel support to the modifier scroll window for enhanced navigation.
[*]New sound effects
[*]Added total lifetime damage stat to units (see in Your Militia)
[*]Removed Herobrine
[/list]

notes.title: A Small Update for a Tuesday
notes.content:
Minor update for today—version 0.91.4 brings these QoL items:
[list]
[*]Abbreviation of large numbers. Dealing 4,031,301,688 points of damage? It'll show up as 4.03B.
[*]Health readout displays a number beyond 9 health so that you're not seeing a pile of ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️s.
[*]The Mimic now takes the damage of the highest-damage unit on the battlefield instead of just adjacent units.
[*]The Dog Catcher now also collects Panthers and Giant Rats. Its laser eye lens has a smudge on it, and it can't tell the difference.
[*]The Hustle Goblin now doubles its damage if you do the most damage ever. It halves its damage if you do not, but won't go below 1 damage.
[*]The Internal Affairs Officer can now "super-protect" a unit. Using that ability will remove it from your Militia immediately.
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update #2 - Lawyer Up(date)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44125927/009f4d82672bace33ae13d269288634c4dc43639.png[/img]

It’s worse than the Hell-Goats—it's Lawyers!

Can you win the game starting with 4 Lawyers in your squad? You'll need to be careful about the Giant Rats they bring with them. But don’t lose hope—you can fight back with two new units, and practice your strategies in the Custom Game mode.

[h1]New Game Mode: Custom Game[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44125927/f6a93f76dadb9cf804c2c3962a293cce79fd7926.png[/img]

Practice in your very own Holodeck by selecting the exact number of bosses and the health curve. Who will be the first to win against a boss with 10 million health?

You may notice that Jon's stuck a few dimmed-out panels on the right. That's for the future—the real reason we're doing Custom Game right now is so that we can add in a bunch of modifiers and starting squad and test them out in advance of introducing them to the missions.

[h1]Vote on Which New Piece to Murder![/h1]
Later this month, on our Discord, we'll hold a vote to see which of this updates new pieces we want to destroy for good. So, what are they?

[h1]New Units: The Enchantress and The Siphon[/h1]
Two new RARE ones: the dangerous Enchantress and the alluring Siphon. Or are those reversed? No, we're going with that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44125927/012ff33d251982947b3ff7ac26feb07756936ba7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44125927/d5da0b392cea300975d2b55e04c246a01bc3dba7.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]The Enchantress[/b] - Mark adjacent Water, Fire and Steam for destruction. For each, increase a random deployed unit’s Base Damage by +1. If this happens, randomly add 1 Water, Fire, or Steam to the Militia.
[*] [b]The Siphon[/b] - Marks all like-units for destruction. if not protected, transfer all their base damage to the Siphon.
[/list]
Again, we plan to murder one of these. It's up to you which.

[h1]Starting Squad: Lawyer Up[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44125927/536a589a11aa4ba8d6684f3c3906a458333c1a59.png[/img]

Defeat any mission with the Frog Squad and unlock the Lawyer Squad. This is an interesting one, our first all-rare starting squad, opening up play styles and strategies.

[b]Lawyer: Gains permanent +2 base damage whenever its multiplier or bonus damage are boosted. If fewer than 3 Giant Rats are deployed, 10% chance to add one to your militia.[/b]

Just watch out for the rodents.

[h1]Balancing and Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Gold: Increased base damage to adjacent units by +1.
[*] Silver: Now grants +1 to bonus damage to adjacent units.
[*] Strength Serum: Now provides +5 bonus damage.
[*] Ascetic: Transforms into a Civilian when one-shotting a boss.
[*] Gold Dragon: Has a global reach for Gold and Silver units.
[*] Slight increase to overall boss health curve to compensate for new units and balance changes.
[*] Strength Serum was only adding in-round damage.
[*] Whiskey now correctly interacts with Constructs.
[*] Fixed a bug where loading from savegame could continue playing music from the intro.
[*] Fixed a bug where the flashing log marquee was showing after players already selected it.
[*] Alchemist was incorrectly duplicating transformed pieces.
[*] And assorted others!
[/list]
[h1]New Achievement[/h1]
Play a Custom Game to unlock this.

That is all!

notes.title: Major Update #1 - Goats From Hell
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44125927/4f21fc9cf89699c6f67fa5b1cee403c8a30c79c3.jpg[/img]

[b]Attention Generals!

We have received a report from the frontlines - the invasion has entered a new phase, and we’ll need to adapt to the changes accordingly.

Be prepared for anything; there is certainly more to come. [/b]

Today, we release our first major update for Million Monster Militia. This update contains a new unit (the GOAT), new missions, and a whole bunch of quality of life improvements, balance changes, and bug fixes.

Thank you all for your continued support, we absolutely love reading your suggestions on the Steam forums and in the Discord. Keep them coming! We look forward to adding more in future updates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44125927/e27ae0cea92e6d10c4efd0983ee539c1c14cfab2.png[/img]

[h1]Release Notes[/h1]
[h2]New Unit:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The GOAT (Demon/Special) - Appears in Mission 3 with the Send to Hell modifier. Each GOAT receives the total damage of every unit you send to Hell, this happens accumulatively through out the mission. Sadly, GOATs cannot be sent to Hell themselves.
[/list]
[h2]New Mechanics:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Modifiers Introduction:[/b] We're introducing a new mission modifier called "Send to Hell." Upon defeating each boss, your militia will undergo redeployment, and you will have to choose a column of units to send to Hell. As a reward for this daring decision, 1 GOAT will be added to your militia. Notably, each time you send units to Hell, all the GOATs in your militia will accumulate the base damage of the consigned units, continually bolstering their own strength.
[/list]
[h2]New Squads:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Vanilla Zombies
[*] Frog Squad
[/list]
[h2]New Missions:[/h2]
We've added two new missions (previously "Ascensions"), taking you to the South and the East Coast.
New missions feature all new bosses and a higher difficulty curve.
[h2]QoL Changes:[/h2]
UI:
[list]
[*] New mission select screen
[*] New boss curve graph for run selection
[*] Added tooltips on hover to a variety of game elements.
[*] Enhanced VFX for portals
[/list]
[h2]Balance Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Webbing - Webbing is now only produced by Aracks and not a selectable item.
[*] Monkey God - Monkey God has a slightly increased chance to roll 0x damage multiplier.
[*] Stasis Ring - Stasis Ring will no longer activate when the boss is defeated that turn.
[*] Alchemist - Now randomly duplicates 1 adjacent Gold, Silver, Empty Canister, or Scrap Metal.
[*] Silver - Now only works on adjacent Weredragons instead of 2 spaces away.
[/list]
[i]Note: we are in the process of looking at the materials Silver, Gold, Scrap Metal, Empty Canisters. The Alchemist and Silver change is a step in the right direction, but in a future update we will be adding a broader synergy to those Items.[/i]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Addressed an issue where the "Groper" and "Mimic" units were unintentionally getting multiplier effect graphics.
[*] Fixed Whiskey uses.
[*] Fixed the boss number displaying the wrong value.
[*] Fixed an issue where boss info pop-up couldn’t be closed.
[/list]

notes.title: Quality of Life, Balances, Fixes, and Quality of Death Update
notes.content:
Dear Generals,

Thanks for freeing the eastern half of America, along with Montreal and its surrounding boroughs. As thanks, we offer version 0.86b, which brings with it a bunch of QoL changes, fixes, and balances. Read on:

[h1]Quality of Life:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added floor mark for destruction and/or protected
[*] Hitting ESC now closes game options.
[*] Hitting ESC from main menu now correctly closes the game.
[*] Clicking off of the Militia view now closes its window.
[*] Modified the Log to be in front of the ADD TO MILITIA window and added keyword colors to the text.
[*] Log icon now flashes when a round is complete, whenever there's new information.
[*] New table probability icon now on the the bottom of the ADD TO MILITIA window to tell you which modifier is currently “in effect”. 
[*] Added commas to boss health and total damage.
[*] The game now remembers fullscreen preference and size and position of window.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Cloning Chamber now reports correctly in the log.
[*] Captain Flag now shows the correct log message.
[*] Fixed the Phoenix to do what its description says, rather than murdering random units.
[*] Medkit will not trigger if the boss is already dead.
[*] Fixed a bug with the probability table affecting the Tower of Retribution's selections.
[*] Fixed typos in some boss bios.
[*] Fixed Engineer description text.
[*] Fixed a bug where Bookshelves and Altars were killing other units randomly.
[*] IAO and EMP now function properly in scenarios involving multiple instances of each. *Note that even if you have multiple IAOs or EMPs on the field, you are still limited to using that ability only once per round.
[*] Rephrased Rat Squad text to be more ratty.
[/list]

[h1]Balancing:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Panther now deals 2x damage for each terrain.
[*] Captain Flag now grants 5x instead of 7x damage.
[*] Hustle Goblin gains +2 Base Damage instead of +1.
[*] Succubus now adds to boss’s damage if the player is 4+ health instead of 6.
[*] Probability modifiers will no longer trigger when the boss dies, except for the Tax Accountant because they have forms to file.
[/list]

notes.title: MMM Early Access Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello Generals,

We’ve been delighted with the reception since our Early Access launch. Thanks to each and everyone one of you who has written a review so far. Reviews are a fantastic way for small studios to get more visibility on Steam, so it is massively appreciated.

Today we’d like to give you an update on our Roadmap going forward. Our first major post-launch update, [b]Goats Go to Hell[/b], will launch in [b]September[/b] and introduce:

[list]
[*] Ascension 2
[*] The GOAT
[*] The Boss Codex
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] And anything else we can fit in!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44125927/c405126a7102793fd0beb441f3928dade3de3cb1.jpg[/img]

We have our vision for what we want Million Monster Militia to become, and we will also be closely looking at all the community feedback. We have already had some great suggestions in our official [url=https://discord.gg/FFUB3VGR2x]Discord[/url], and we look forward to reading more!

Keep fighting the good fight,

The Million Monster Militia Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44125927/f8904de3e414c8496cf3445ce124c779227d7cab.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Million Monster Militia Launches into Early Access!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=vp9fPx3tdN0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]We Have Launched![/h1]
Today is the day! Million Monster Militia is available now! Get it here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2358770/Million_Monster_Militia/

[url=https://discord.gg/u5KduNqFkM]Join our official Discord[/url] to keep up to date with the community throughout Early Access. We’ll be publishing our Roadmap over the next few days!

See you on the Battlefield!

 - The Million Monster Militia Team  

[h1]About Million Monster Militia[/h1]

[b]Assemble a Team of Unlikely Heroes:[/b] You start in Boston, with a band of Civilians armed with nothing but hope—and you're up against a 3-story tall boss demon. Every turn, you trade blows, regroup, and add a new unit—a choice from half a dozen randomly-selected unit types. Do you go for power and recruit a Soldier who will train your Civilians into battle-hardened troops? Do you channel the occult, with a Succubus who will turn them all into power-leeching Vampires? Or do you go scorched Earth and launch a Tactical Nuke, covering the land in Radioactive Waste so you can raise an army of Mutants? With every choice, you're shaping your army and your overall strategy.
 
[b]Create a Strategy from Synergies:[/b] As the general, your role transcends micromanagement. Where and how your troops engage the enemy is out of your hands; your job to build a team with complementary skills and strengths. The Crimson Terror gets stronger with every nearby Beast. A quintet of Mecha will combine into the mighty Moltron. Even Sheep have their role in the battle: recruit a Dragon that grows stronger with fire, and let it ignite your flock, transforming the simple herd into a strategic advantage. Your superpower is the ability to create unexpected, game-breaking combinations that send your enemies back to Hell.
 
[b]Free America from the Oppressors![/b] With each triumph, you're one step closer to freeing the nation's cities (plus newly annexed Montreal) from its occupiers. So, embrace the chaos, master the synergies, and lead an army of unlikely heroes to victory. MMM is now available on Steam Early Access. Grab your chance to be the savior and take America back!

notes.title: Million Monster Militia in Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[b]Have you ever fantasized about being the hero America desperately needs?[/b] Well, the time has come to make that dream a reality with Million Monster Militia. Picture this: it's you against 50 towering bosses, each holding a key city of the United States hostage, including the newly annexed Montreal. You've got the grit, the determination, but now, you need the army.

PLAY THE DEMO!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2358770

[b]Every turn is a gamble.[/b] It's a roguelike recruitment sim where you rally beasts, soldiers, mechas and even the unexpected - from radioactive waste to mad scientists. You're not just building an army; you're crafting an unstoppable force, a rag-tag legion with incredible synergistic powers. The catch? Once your troops hit the battlefield, you've got no control over them. You've got to strategically assemble the right fighters, the right combinations that will kick those giant bosses into outer space.

[b]The strategy lies in the unpredictable chaos.[/b] You have 150 troop types to choose from, and the line-up will change every run. But, each choice, every win, brings you one step closer to liberating 'Murica. Picture the victory, the cheers of the crowd as you free each city. That could be you.

[b]Don't let Nyarlathotep and his goons turn 'Murica into their playground.[/b] Grab your chance to be the savior, the strategist, the leader. Because, in the end, you're not just playing a game - you're taking 'Murica back!

notes.title: Try WITHIN A DEAD CITY from our fellow Tiny Mass Games dev Moonroof!
notes.content:
You might know Moonroof from their cozy farming roguelite, Moondrop. They're part of a greater Massachusetts-based initiative-to-do-awesome-small games called Tiny Mass Games. Check out their next thing:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2345910/Within_a_Dead_City/

[h1]Within a Dead Whaaa?[/h1]
It's a tiny 4X game about managing autonomous heroes as they search for gold and glory inside the cursed capital of a fallen empire. Grow your outpost, place bounties on monsters, and cast spells to save your heroes from their own overconfident decisions.

[h1]It Ain't Easy Running an Adventurer's Guild[/h1]
You have to deal with monster attacks, angry gods, and cowardly heroes. Money can solve a lot of problems (and motivate cowardly heroes), but a good strategy demands more than just bags of cash. You'll need to manage heroes as they grow from rookies into champions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44125927/d904f1a4949f15ed48392d50815c809e9a4db9fb.gif[/img]

[h1]Let Someone Else Do the Dangerous Work[/h1]
There's riches to be found inside the dead city. Hire foolhardy and fearless adventurers to bring it back to you! Heroes will act on their on accord: slaying monsters, raiding lairs, and defending your guild outpost. Try to keep them out of trouble - their greed can lead them to bite off more than they can chew.

[h1]Find Forbidden Knowledge Within Ancient Ruins[/h1]
The old gods are jealous gods, and they will do all they can to keep their temples safe from intruders. Balance economic growth against steadily growing corruption. Defend your outpost from the encroaching monster lairs. If you and your heroes can survive in the ruins, you'll be wealthy beyond your wildest dreams.

[h1]Also Check Out Moondrop![/h1]

In case you're in a farming mood, and are open to your entire mountain being nuked from orbit every week, because it's the only way to be sure. No, wait, not that last part...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1417750/Moondrop/

...or maybe that does happen.
